Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached are the completed onboarding form (greenfield_onboard_form_v2.pdf) and our initial SKU spreadsheet. We're trying to get a provisional PO in place so we can kick off the pilot next week. Key ask: can you issue a PO number tied to a $50k spend cap for the pilot and leave line items as provisional while we finalize exact quantities?

Quick notes on the attachment:
- The spreadsheet currently lists three SKUs (in trial quantities) — row totals are estimates.
- We flagged one SKU (GF-API-PRIME) as "TBD" for final pricing — we expect a firm number by Jul 28.

Can you confirm next steps and expected timing for a provisional PO? We need the PO number to start our procurement approvals on our side.

Thanks,
Mira

Attachments: greenfield_onboard_form_v2.pdf, gf_lineitems_draft.csv

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding + PO request for Greenfield AI

Thanks Mira — looping in Laura (procurement ops) and Ben (vendor activation) to help with PO issuance. A couple of quick clarifications before we generate a provisional PO: 

1) SKU mismatch: the CSV you sent has a ‘GF-OBSERVE’ line with quantity 0 but a non-zero unit price; is that intentional? If it should be omitted we can drop it from the provisional line items.
2) Spend cap: you requested $50k — do you want that as a hard cap or a provisional cap with an overage approval path? For pilots we typically do a provisional cap and allow a one-time overrun with manual approval up to 10%.
3) Timing: if you can provide the corrected SKU CSV by EOD Jul 28 we can issue a provisional PO number by Jul 29 (provisional PO will show as PO-73021 and include a note that final line items will be reconciled within 14 days).

Laura / Ben — can you confirm the temporary credit/overage workflow and whether we need a signed addendum for the provisional PO? If we can't reconcile before the pilot start, I'm proposing we issue PO-73021 with a $50k provisional cap and an explicit reconciliation step in the PO notes.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

Hi Priyom — attached the corrected line items (gf_lineitems_corrected.csv). A couple points: 

- We removed GF-OBSERVE as requested; quantities and unit prices are now aligned to our internal approval sheet.
- GF-API-PRIME pricing is now firm at $0.12/token for the pilot quantities.
- Tom has approved a hard stop at $50k for the pilot; they will not authorize automatic overrun. If an overrun is needed we'll submit a manual request via procurement.

Attachments: gf_lineitems_corrected.csv

Please proceed with the provisional PO path you outlined. If you need a signed addendum, we can e-sign it today.

Best,

Folks — confirming next steps from Procurement Ops: 

- Provisional PO issued: PO-73021 (see attached stub provisional_po_73021.pdf). This PO is scoped to a hard spend cap of $50,000 and includes the line items from gf_lineitems_corrected.csv as provisional entries.
- Reconciliation requirement: Vendor must submit final invoice(s) and a final line-item reconciliation within 14 days of PO issuance. Any changes to quantities/pricing must be approved in writing by Redwood procurement (procurement@redwood.ai).
- Overage policy: Since Greenfield elected a hard stop, no automatic overrun will be permitted. Any request for additional spend will be treated as a separate PO request and must go through standard procurement approval.
- Action items for Greenfield: please return signed addendum (if you want it) and upload final invoice(s) to the Drive folder we shared. If you need the PO in a different format (internal vendor portal), let us know and Ben will provide the vendor token.

Ben — please create the vendor record in the ledger and attach the vendor token to PO-73021. Priyom — I'll mark the onboarding ticket PROC-1247 as "PO issued" and move to the vendor activation queue.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: provisional_po_73021.pdf
